links.outcome: LLM performance on realistic clinical-pathway cases versus inflated static benchmark scores
links.effect: Top-performing model reached Case Accuracy of just 35.7% on 1,407 real case reports, and static benchmarks are described as giving inflated scores.
links.quote: Our evaluation of 26 models on LiveClin reveals the profound difficulty of these real-world scenarios, with the top-performing model achieving a Case Accuracy of just 35.7%.

unlisted_practices: Live, biannually updated benchmark built from recent peer-reviewed case reports to resist data contamination and knowledge obsolescence
AI-human workflow with physician verification for constructing evaluation cases

screen.reason: Introduces LiveClin, a continuously updated live benchmark dataset of multimodal clinical case reports, and evaluates 26 models against physician performance without testing specific organizational deployment safeguards.
